name: ruins_of_ahnqiraj
notes: DRAFT: this raid plan was written offline in task B1 (TortoiseBots-audit RAID-PREP-aq20.md) from the world database census of map 509 (309 spawns, 34 entries; sql/base), the core's ruins_of_ahnqiraj instance and boss scripts and the server's map 509 navmesh (30 tiles). Not mapped, not live-checked: the GM-invisible mapping walk (B2) and the first live run are still to do; dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.

Packs: the dungeongen skeleton's 132 pull groups (302 units) become 102 pulls (230 units). Not in a pull: the 49 Rajaxx event units (the 7 captains 15385-15392 and their six escorts each, 15344 Swarmguard Needler and 15387 Qiraji Warrior: the hold fights them), Andorov and his 4 Kaldorei Elite (15471/15473, faction 1608, gossip), the 6 bosses, and the 19 Canal Frenzy (15505) in the sunken water channel west of the Moam corridor (z 4.7-13.8, below the route: the skeleton's one pack of them was its needs_walk failure). Rule: lone spawns chain where they stand within 15 yd on one floor (|dz| <= 4) and the server walk between them is at most 2.2 times their distance plus 8 yd, up to 12 units; a pull's reach (radius + 3) takes the lone spawns standing in it; a patrol or a creature-group unit never moves. Radius = the pack's own spread from its centre + 5 yd (the raid pull rule), at most 35. 40 pulls carry a patrol block (all 40 patrolling trash spawns; the 41st path is Kurinnaxx's own). One creature group is not a pack: spawn 1242591, a Silicate Feeder, carries five Vile Scarabs 1125 yd apart, so they stand alone.

Boss order: Kurinnaxx (15348), General Rajaxx (15341, the event), Moam (15340), Buru the Gorger (15370), Ayamiss the Hunter (15369), Ossirian the Unscarred (15339). The world DB, the core's scripts and the Turtle instance guide agree on the roster and the order; the DB and the core also have Captain Tuubid (15392) as the second captain of Rajaxx's waves (generic_scripts 153920), which the guide counts as part of the event.

Rajaxx's event: the instance loads Andorov only once Kurinnaxx is DONE (instance_ruins_of_ahnqiraj.cpp Update); his menu 6629's option 0 (gossip_scripts 6629 -> generic_scripts 154710) starts his run to the hall, and the first wave starts about 12 s after he reaches it (creature_movement_scripts 1547103 -> 153911). The waves then chain captain by captain, and the hold ends when instance data 2 (TYPE_RAJAXX) reads 3, Rajaxx's death (creature_ai_events 1534101/1534102). Pulling any wave unit also starts Andorov's script (OnCreatureEnterCombat), so the gossip only says when; the hall's two Qiraji Gladiator pairs are pulled after it, because the wave units stand in the hall and would aggro on entry.

Ossirian's crystals (180619) are summoned by the instance two at a time near the used one (SpawnNewCrystals) and the weakness school is random: no plan step can click a moving object, so the bosses' own fight strategy runs the crystal and the boss stand is on his platform. Buru's 6 eggs (summoned at z -63.5), Ayamiss's larvae and hornets and Moam's Mana Fiends are summoned by their bosses: no step.

The map has no static door, lever or key: its 7 game objects are all Scarab Coffers (180691), which are left alone; door 176149 is summoned by the instance while any boss is in combat and deleted after (Update), so it gates nothing.

Every pull and every boss carries an approach stand (102 pulls, 5 bosses): 16-30 yd from a member, on the pack's floor, a complete server path from the point before it, 20 yd clear of every pull made later and of every Rajaxx wave spawn. The first stand of a leg is the leg's `to`. plan-check: ok, 352 points, 0 failures, 0 run-leader hops, 40 warnings (every patrol's period is an estimate the walk measures).

legs.name: entrance_hall
notes: 19 pulls (37 units) on the entrance terrace (z 31.7-36.2): two Qiraji Gladiator pairs (15324), five Hive'Zara wasp packs with their patrols (15325/15327), five Qiraji Swarmguard patrols (15343) and 10 Vile Scarabs (15168). Andorov's camp (15471 and four 15473, faction 1608) stands here: friendly, in no pull.

legs.name: kurinnaxx
notes: 6 pulls (14 units) in the arena below the terrace (z 19.7-25.4): four wasp packs and two Vile Scarabs, then Kurinnaxx. His Wide Slash 25814 is a frontal cleave (the ai_boss_tactic `behind` row) and Mortal Wound 25646 stacks on the tank: without a tank swap (community patch 326) the tank's healing taken falls 10 % per stack.

legs.name: andorov_camp

gossip.fail_text: Andorov's menu offers no "Let's find out.": the instance only loads him after Kurinnaxx is dead, and his script is what starts the event.

notes: The gossip that starts Rajaxx's event: Andorov (15471) is loaded when Kurinnaxx is DONE, and option 0 of menu 6629 begins his run to the hall. The leg is here so the talk happens outside the hall, before a wave can be aggroed.

legs.name: general_rajaxx

wait_for.fail_text: Rajaxx's event did not finish: a wave is still up, or a wave evaded and the event reset (Andorov's script despawns and respawns the captains; each wave has 180 s).

notes: 3 pulls (5 units): the hall's two Qiraji Gladiator pairs and a Vile Scarab, then the event's hold. The raid holds on the spot and fights the seven waves; the hold ends on instance data 2 reading 3 (Rajaxx dead). The wave units are pre-placed in the hall and are no pulls.

legs.name: moam
notes: 29 pulls (70 units) up the north corridor: five Hive'Zara scarab swarms (15461/15462, one linked pack each, radius 35), nine Obsidian Destroyers and two Flesh Hunters on their patrols, seven Vile Scarabs; then Moam. The Canal Frenzy in the channel below are in no pull. Moam drains mana and turns to stone when his mana fills (25685): the raid's Mages and Priests Mana Burn him.

legs.name: buru_the_gorger
notes: 10 pulls (20 units) on the plateau south-west of the hall (15320 Hive'Zara Soldier, 15323 Hive'Zara Sandstalker, three Flesh Hunters, one Vile Scarab), the descent, and Buru's pit (z -63.8). Buru summons six eggs at z -63.5 and walks at a random target; killing an egg within 5 yd stops him (boss_buru.cpp OnEggExploded).

legs.name: ayamiss_the_hunter
notes: 27 pulls (76 units) in the west hive: 37 Silicate Feeders (15333), six Drones, six Collectors and six Tail Lashers, eleven wasps and nine stingers; then Ayamiss. She flies, summons 20 swarmers every 60 s and paralyses a random raider to feed a larva: no plan step can cover it.

legs.name: ossirian_the_unscarred
notes: 8 pulls (8 units): the eight Anubisath Guardians (15355), each on its own patrol; then Ossirian on his platform (z 105.5). His Strength of Ossirian (25176) only falls to a crystal's weakness debuff, and the crystals are summoned during the fight (no step).
